title: Lawrence Hall of Science
geometryBasis: Named OSM footprint together with USDA summer aerial geometry and a one-meter bare-earth USGS 3DEP survey. The roof and terrace controls remain tied to the original federal image.
sectionBasis: UC Berkeley's 2021 Historic Resources Technical Report identifies concrete forms and low, faceted roofs. The known CC0 Qualla gallery view establishes the cast concrete rib proportions; the plaza photograph shows the paving and low wall profile.
limitations: The geographic outline and plaza features are mapped. Roof ridge elevations and portions of the concrete elevations use aerial and photographic scale estimates.
The model covers the current building and immediately connected public plaza and terraces. Exhibition interiors, moving installations and sculpture are outside scope.
